issues.desc: background.md Trigger Event and Conversational Texture reference B-c6cf multiple times without a one-sentence explanation of what B-c6cf is. A new reader cannot understand the relationship or the waiver being referenced.

background.md Trigger Event uses the notation CHK-002:happy:2 waiver without defining the CHK-id:category:index format. A new reader unfamiliar with Lattice verificationIntent notation cannot understand this reference on first appearance.

checklist.json CHK-002 context offers mark with skipUnderParallel as a remedy option for the lattice-baseline TIMEOUT, but this field does not exist in smoke-manifest.json schema (schema shows only name/tags/timeoutMs/skip) and is absent from the entire source tree. The implementer would be directed toward a non-existent system capability.

checklist.json CHK-003 context contains the generic placeholder B-xxxx in CHANGELOG Unreleased entry naming this story (B-xxxx) instead of the actual story ID B-2d6c, which may cause confusion for the implementer.
